audience: web and IT teams who monitor sites and cron jobs with StatusCake

useCases.title: Find checks that are down and see how long
useCases.text: The AI lists uptime checks by status or tag, then reads the up and down periods, test runs with status code and response time, and alerts of a check.

useCases.title: Check SSL certificates for expiry and problems
useCases.text: The AI lists SSL checks with valid-until date, issuer and flags such as expired, broken, revoked or mixed content, and sorts them by expiry.

useCases.title: Review page load time and size
useCases.text: The AI lists pagespeed checks with the latest load time, page size and request count and reads the history of one check.

useCases.title: Check that cron jobs and workers still ping in
useCases.text: The AI lists heartbeat checks with their status and period, and reads one to see when it last received a ping and what its ping URL is.

useCases.title: Start monitoring a site, certificate or cron job
useCases.text: The AI creates an uptime check for a URL, host or IP, an SSL check, or a heartbeat check for a cron job. It can look up the contact groups to alert.

useCases.title: Update uptime checks or schedule maintenance windows
useCases.text: The AI pauses or resumes an uptime check, changes its settings, or schedules a maintenance window that silences alerts for checks or tags.
